execution.interface: fit_spread(training_features, training_rates, metadata) -> object.spread_rate(features). Five measured inputs: wind m/s, measurement height m, dead-fuel moisture fraction, fuel height m, dry load kg/m2. Return nonnegative m/s. Equal-country RMSE on complete held-out countries from Anderson2015. Missing inputs excluded; no invented fuel or slope inputs.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Predict shrubland wildfire spread rates from measured environmental and fuel conditions.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Fire-spread prediction informs understanding of fire behavior and planning for fire hazards.

papers.title: A generic, empirical-based model for predicting rate of fire spread in shrublands
papers.primary_goal: Develop and validate empirical shrubland fire-spread predictions using measured fires.
papers.task_relation: The local task fits spread laws to measured Anderson2015 shrubland observations. It is a bounded source adaptation, not an operational fire forecast or validation for fuels outside the observed conditions.
